modalLead: A bookmark you delete in the health view now disappears from the dashboard at once, rather than lingering there until the next page reload. And a monitored service that stops responding is flagged in the header apart from an ordinary dead link.

items.text: Deleting a bookmark in the health view clears it from the dashboard immediately — the health view deletes through its own endpoint and never touched the dashboard's in-memory copies, so a deleted bookmark stayed on the grid — and in any smart collection it matched — until the page was reloaded. It now drops from every live copy at once: the grid, the collections and the health list all update with no reload.

The header flags a monitor that is down, apart from a broken link — a monitored bookmark that is unreachable right now is counted separately from an ordinary dead link, with its own badge. When the number of down monitors rises, the health icon pulses once to catch your eye — only on a rise, so a reload onto an existing outage or a recovery stays quiet, and behind a 10-minute cooldown so a flapping monitor cannot pulse the header on every check. It shares the broken red and is told apart by the movement; clicking it opens the monitored list. Respects reduced-motion and the no-animations setting.
